list.name: enterprise
list.label: Enterprise
list.query: SELECT nm_enterprise AS __text, id_enterprise AS __value FROM enterprises ORDER BY nm_enterprise

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT nm_site AS __text, id_site AS __value FROM sites WHERE id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) ORDER BY nm_site

list.name: area
list.label: Area
list.query: SELECT nm_area AS __text, id_area AS __value FROM areas WHERE id_site IN ($site) ORDER BY nm_area

list.name: line
list.label: Line / Equipment
list.query: SELECT nm_equipment AS __text, id_equipment AS __value FROM equipments WHERE id_area IN ($area) ORDER BY nm_equipment

list.name: shift
list.label: Shift
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT cd_shift AS __text, cd_shift AS __value FROM equipment_oee_shift WHERE cd_shift IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

options.content:
### Factory / OEE analysis — the plant-manager & tee-validation lens
Exploratory business view over the **F3 shadow Gold tables** (`packiot_analytics`: `equipment_oee_shift/_hourly/_daily`, `area_/site_oee_*`, `production_orders_runtime`, `equipment_events`, `data_quality_event`). OEE / A / P / Q are stored **0–1** and rendered ×100 as %. Scope with the **$enterprise → $site → $area → $line → $shift** chain; `$grain` switches the trend panels between shift / hour / day rollups.

**Reading blanks (v2 contract):** with plc-sim + Incoplast data some loss buckets read 0 by design — downtime *reason categories*, `changeover_time`, `idle_starved/idle_blocked` are emitted by real client PLCs; they light up when **CPACK real data lands via the tee**. The **Data-quality strip** (bottom) tells you which numbers the engine clamped/flagged in the window — read it before trusting a KPI.

panels.title: OEE — A × P × Q decomposition (window aggregate)
OEE %
panels.description: Mean OEE over the scoped window (equipment_oee_shift.oee ×100). World-class ≥ 85%. This is the engine's authoritative rollup, not a raw-tick re-derivation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND((AVG(r.oee)*100)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now()

panels.title: Availability %
panels.description: Mean oee_a ×100 = uptime / planned time. Availability losses = breakdowns + setup. Target ≥ 90%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND((AVG(r.oee_a)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Availability %" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now()

panels.title: Performance %
panels.description: Mean oee_p ×100 = actual vs ideal rate. Performance losses = minor stops + reduced speed. Target ≥ 95%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND((AVG(r.oee_p)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Performance %" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now()

panels.title: Quality %
panels.description: Mean oee_q ×100 = good / total. Quality losses = scrap + startup yield. Target ≥ 98%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND((AVG(r.oee_q)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Quality %" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now()

panels.title: OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality (waterfall)
panels.description: The multiplicative decomposition on one axis: each factor is a % ≤ 100, and OEE is their product. The gap of each bar below 100% is that factor's loss share. If OEE looks low, the shortest A/P/Q bar names the dominant loss family.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND((AVG(r.oee)*100)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_a)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Availability %", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_p)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Performance %", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_q)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Quality %" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now()

panels.title: Net produced
panels.description: SUM(net) over the scoped window (good units).

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, SUM(r.net) AS "Net" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now()

panels.title: Scrap
panels.description: SUM(scrap) over the window (defective units). Quality loss in raw counts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, SUM(r.scrap) AS "Scrap" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now()

panels.title: Downtime (window)
panels.description: SUM(downtime) seconds over the window → the total Availability time loss.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, SUM(r.downtime) AS "Downtime" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring})

panels.title: Losses — downtime Pareto & the six big losses
Downtime Pareto — by reason category
panels.description: Total stopped seconds per downtime reason (equipment_events, coalescing desc_category→cd_category). In plc-sim data reasons are uncategorized → one '(uncategorized)' bar; real client PLCs send category/subcategory codes (downtime_reason mapping) so this ranks true root causes when CPACK data lands.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ev.desc_category,''), NULLIF(ev.cd_category,''), '(uncategorized)') AS reason, SUM(ev.duration) AS "stopped_s" FROM equipment_events ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=ev.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_event) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($line) AND ev.duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

panels.title: Downtime Pareto — by machine
panels.description: Total stopped seconds per machine (equipment_events.duration). Populated today from plc-sim — the honest 'which machine bleeds the most time' view even before reason codes arrive.

targets.rawSql: SELECT eq.nm_equipment AS machine, SUM(ev.duration) AS "stopped_s" FROM equipment_events ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=ev.id_equipment JOIN equipments eq ON eq.id_equipment=ev.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_event) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($line) AND ev.duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

panels.title: Downtime Pareto detail (cumulative %)
panels.description: Reason × count × total duration with the running cumulative % of downtime — the classic 80/20 read: the reasons above the 80% line are where to focus.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ev.desc_category,''), NULLIF(ev.cd_category,''), '(uncategorized)') AS reason, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(ev.duration) AS dur FROM equipment_events ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=ev.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_event) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($line) AND ev.duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT reason, events, dur AS stopped_s, ROUND((100.0*dur/NULLIF(SUM(dur) OVER (),0))::numeric,1) AS pct, ROUND((100.0*SUM(dur) OVER (ORDER BY dur DESC)/NULLIF(SUM(dur) OVER (),0))::numeric,1) AS cum_pct FROM d ORDER BY dur DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30

panels.title: Six big losses (time-equivalent)
panels.description: Classic OEE loss taxonomy in seconds, derived from the shift rollup: Availability = breakdowns + setup/changeover; Performance = minor stops + reduced speed (running_time×(1-oee_p)); Quality = scrap (running_time×(1-oee_q)). changeover_time / idle_starved / idle_blocked read 0 in plc-sim — they populate from real PLC event streams. (#6 Startup/yield loss is not separately tracked; it folds into Quality.)

targets.rawSql: WITH r AS (SELECT r.running_time, r.stopped_time, r.downtime, r.changeover_time, COALESCE(r.idle_starved,0)+COALESCE(r.idle_blocked,0)+COALESCE(r.idle_time,0) AS idle_all, r.oee_p, r.oee_q FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring})) SELECT loss, secs FROM ( SELECT '1 Breakdowns (unplanned stop)' AS loss, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(downtime-changeover_time,0)),0) AS secs, 1 o FROM r UNION ALL SELECT '2 Setup & changeover', COALESCE(SUM(changeover_time),0), 2 FROM r UNION ALL SELECT '3 Idling & minor stops', COALESCE(SUM(idle_all),0), 3 FROM r UNION ALL SELECT '4 Reduced speed', COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(running_time*(1-COALESCE(oee_p,1)),0)),0)::bigint, 4 FROM r UNION ALL SELECT '5 Scrap / process defects', COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(running_time*(1-COALESCE(oee_q,1)),0)),0)::bigint, 5 FROM r ) s ORDER BY o

panels.title: Trends — production vs target & OEE over time ($grain)
Production vs proportional target
panels.description: Net (good) + gross production against the engine's proportional_target per $grain bucket. Targets read ~0 in sim (production_targets not seeded) → the target line lifts off the axis with real onboarding config.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.ts_value::timestamptz AS time, SUM(r.net) AS "Net", SUM(r.gross) AS "Gross", SUM(r.proportional_target) AS "Proportional target" FROM equipment_oee_ r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value::timestamptz) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OEE / A / P / Q trend
panels.description: Mean OEE and its A/P/Q factors (×100) per $grain bucket — watch which factor drives an OEE dip.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.ts_value::timestamptz AS time, ROUND((AVG(r.oee)*100)::numeric,1) AS "OEE", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_a)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Availability", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_p)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Performance", ROUND((AVG(r.oee_q)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Quality" FROM equipment_oee_ r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value::timestamptz) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OEE by line × shift (heatmap)
panels.description: Mean OEE % per machine (rows) × shift 1/2/3 (columns) over the window — a pivot heatmap. Green cells = healthy, red = problem shift. Spots a machine that only underperforms on nights.

targets.rawSql: SELECT eq.nm_equipment AS machine, ROUND((AVG(r.oee) FILTER (WHERE r.cd_shift='1')*100)::numeric,1) AS "Shift 1", ROUND((AVG(r.oee) FILTER (WHERE r.cd_shift='2')*100)::numeric,1) AS "Shift 2", ROUND((AVG(r.oee) FILTER (WHERE r.cd_shift='3')*100)::numeric,1) AS "Shift 3", ROUND((AVG(r.oee)*100)::numeric,1) AS "All" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment JOIN equipments eq ON eq.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY eq.nm_equipment ORDER BY "All" ASC NULLS LAST

panels.title: OEE by machine
panels.description: Mean OEE % per machine over the window — rank the fleet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT eq.nm_equipment AS machine, ROUND((AVG(r.oee)*100)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment JOIN equipments eq ON eq.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IN (${shift:sqlstring}) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

panels.title: OEE by shift
panels.description: Mean OEE % per shift (cd_shift) over the window — is one shift systematically worse?

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Shift '||r.cd_shift AS shift, ROUND((AVG(r.oee)*100)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %" FROM equipment_oee_shift r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.cd_shift IS NOT NULL AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY r.cd_shift ORDER BY r.cd_shift

panels.title: OEE by day
panels.description: Mean OEE % per calendar day (equipment_oee_daily) — the day-over-day trend for the scoped hierarchy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.ts_value::timestamptz AS time, ROUND((AVG(r.oee)*100)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %" FROM equipment_oee_daily r JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=r.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value::timestamptz) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND r.id_equipment IN ($line) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OEE by area (area_oee_shift)
panels.description: Mean OEE % per area straight from the area-level Gold rollup — exercises area_oee_shift, the aggregate the site/plant view reads.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.nm_area AS area, ROUND((AVG(r.oee)*100)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %" FROM area_oee_shift r JOIN areas a ON a.id_area=r.id_area WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts_value) AND a.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND a.id_site IN ($site) AND a.id_area IN ($area) AND r.running_time > 0 AND r.ts_value <= now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

panels.title: Production orders — runtime detail
panels.description: One row per PO run segment (production_orders_runtime) with OEE/A/P/Q (×100), net/gross/scrap and time buckets. Sorted newest first. Click a row's link column to jump to the Data-quality board for the same window. Cross-check against board 09 (v2-equipment) PO runtimes.

links.title: Open Data-quality board for this window

targets.rawSql: SELECT por.id_production_order AS po, po.nm_production_order AS name, eq.nm_equipment AS machine, ROUND((por.oee*100)::numeric,1) AS oee, ROUND((por.oee_a*100)::numeric,1) AS a, ROUND((por.oee_p*100)::numeric,1) AS p, ROUND((por.oee_q*100)::numeric,1) AS q, por.net_production AS net, por.gross_production AS gross, (por.gross_production-por.net_production) AS scrap, por.running_time AS run_s, por.downtime AS down_s, lower(por.runtime_timerange) AS ts_start, upper(por.runtime_timerange) AS ts_end, po.status FROM production_orders_runtime por JOIN production_orders po ON po.id_production_order=por.id_production_order JOIN equipments eq ON eq.id_equipment=por.id_equipment JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment=por.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(lower(por.runtime_timerange)) AND e.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND e.id_site IN ($site) AND e.id_area IN ($area) AND por.id_equipment IN ($line) ORDER BY lower(por.runtime_timerange) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

panels.title: Data-quality context — which numbers were clamped / flagged
DQ events (window)
panels.description: Total data_quality_event rows in the window for the scoped enterprise — how many computed values tripped an invariant. 0 = clean.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*) AS "DQ events" FROM data_quality_event dqe WHERE $__timeFilter(dqe.detected_at) AND dqe.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND (dqe.id_equipment IS NULL OR dqe.id_equipment IN ($line))

panels.title: Errors (severity=error)
panels.description: data_quality_event rows with severity='error' — hard invariant breaches (NET_GT_GROSS, NEGATIVE_METRIC, OEE_GT_1) before clamping.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Errors" FROM data_quality_event dqe WHERE dqe.severity='error' AND $__timeFilter(dqe.detected_at) AND dqe.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND (dqe.id_equipment IS NULL OR dqe.id_equipment IN ($line))

panels.title: Worst OEE observed
panels.description: MAX(observed_value) for rule OEE_GT_1 — the highest pre-clamp OEE the engine saw (should be ≤1.0; >1 means an upstream count/time inconsistency was clamped).

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND(MAX(dqe.observed_value)::numeric,3) AS "Worst OEE" FROM data_quality_event dqe WHERE dqe.rule='OEE_GT_1' AND $__timeFilter(dqe.detected_at) AND dqe.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND (dqe.id_equipment IS NULL OR dqe.id_equipment IN ($line))

panels.title: Equipment affected
panels.description: Distinct id_equipment with at least one DQ event in the window — how widespread the flagging is.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT dqe.id_equipment) AS "Equipment" FROM data_quality_event dqe WHERE $__timeFilter(dqe.detected_at) AND dqe.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND (dqe.id_equipment IS NULL OR dqe.id_equipment IN ($line))

panels.title: Data-quality events by rule
panels.description: Count per rule in the window. INVARIANT_CLAMPED_* = the engine silently corrected a value (the KPI you see is the clamped one); OEE_GT_1 / NET_GT_GROSS / NEGATIVE_METRIC = raw breaches. A tall bar here means 'trust the matching KPIs less for this window'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dqe.rule AS rule, COUNT(*) AS "events" FROM data_quality_event dqe WHERE $__timeFilter(dqe.detected_at) AND dqe.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND (dqe.id_equipment IS NULL OR dqe.id_equipment IN ($line)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Data-quality detail — rule × equipment
panels.description: Per rule × grain × equipment: event count, worst observed value, last seen. The audit trail behind every clamped/flagged number in the window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dqe.rule, dqe.grain, dqe.id_equipment, dqe.severity, COUNT(*) AS events, MAX(dqe.observed_value) AS worst_observed, MAX(dqe.detected_at) AS last_seen FROM data_quality_event dqe WHERE $__timeFilter(dqe.detected_at) AND dqe.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND (dqe.id_equipment IS NULL OR dqe.id_equipment IN ($line)) GROUP BY dqe.rule, dqe.grain, dqe.id_equipment, dqe.severity ORDER BY events DESC, worst_observed DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300
